summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark 4.1, enhancements to the REST specification, and upcoming releases including Iceberg 1.11.0 and 1.12.0. Key topics include file commit strategies, logging improvements, and the introduction of a generic CatalogObjectIdentifier.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Discussion on file status/change detection and partition tuple modeling
Implementation of a 404 response for the /v1/config endpoint
Proposal for adding relative paths to the v4 spec
